title: Gece Yarısı Resitali
author: Beyza Aksoy
description: Created in a laboratory and raised as a weapon, twenty-one-year-old Marin Kalentari can shatter buildings and kill without a touch. After surviving the massacre of her fellow psychic subjects, she infiltrates Sapphire’s Colorado Academy to avenge them. Her target is Salem Pardis, the organization’s deadliest assassin, and the man who killed the father figure who saved her. Assigned to a team hunting Subject 507, Marin must pursue her own secret identity alongside the enemy she is dangerously drawn to. Months later, she wakes inside the Academy with fractured memories, her powers gone and her body frighteningly fragile. To discover how her mission unraveled, she must turn to Salem, whose secrets threaten everything she believes about her past. Moving between a covert operation and its haunting aftermath, Midnight Recital weaves psychic powers, revenge, and dangerous attraction into a dark story of a young woman struggling to reclaim a life others have claimed as their own.
